note: Set A binds the state-space matrices correctly (A_d=α, B_d=1−α, C_d=α, D_d=1−α as the input transmission matrix) and gives plot readings with quotes that actually reference the plotted values (e.g., magnitude ≈ −12.5 dB at 1.00 Hz). Set B repeatedly uses the figure caption as the quote for Bode-plot values (phase −75°, magnitude −12 dB at 1.00 Hz), so those claims are unsupported, and it adds misread points (phase −30° at 0.10 Hz, −75° at 0.5 Hz) plus a garbled property name ('input mission matrix' for the input transmission matrix). Both sets contain duplicates and one claim each that contradicts its own quote (−80° vs. −75 at 1.00 Hz), and both approximate the −3 dB point as ≈0.2–0.3 Hz instead of the stated 0.25 Hz. Overall A keeps the needed conditions and correct bindings more consistently, so it is the better set.
